from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this judgment document as named in the source")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The case cause/案由 specified in this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
